messages:
sam-partners: Quick thread to confirm the "mini-integration" bundle for the cloud marketplace pilots (Snowflake + Databricks + vector store adapters). Need a final artifact list and owner assignments so we can schedule the joint announcement.

carmen-ps: Status: built connector adapters for Qdrant + Pinecone, Delta export ready for Databricks, CSV + share prep for Snowflake. Holding on legal signoff for the license.

tariq-eng: Technical constraints: embedding files must be float32 .npy, include sha256, and embedding-config.json with model: 'redwood-embed-v1-1024', tokenizer-hash. Also include a tiny docker image for the adapter (tagged) to avoid SDK mismatch.

maya-legal: Maya (legal) here: we need the README to contain data provenance + explicit non-production clause. Propose "Redwood Demo License v1 - Evaluation Only" and a one-line redistribution prohibition. Also include contact_email in metadata.json for takedown requests.

hugo-marketing: Marketing asks: 1) a 45s screencap of the mini flow (Snowflake -> embed -> Qdrant query), 2) a one-pager targeted at platform owners (value props + expected costs). Can we get a "quick demo mode" with 50 rows?

carmen-ps: I'll add a mini_sample_50.csv and a preseeded qdrant collection export.

tariq-eng: Action checklist:
- produce artifacts (csv, delta, embeddings .npy, embedding-config.json, metadata.json) - owner: carmen-ps - due +2 days
- docker adapter image + adapter_integration_test.sh - owner: tariq-eng - due +3 days
- legal license text + marketplace checklist - owner: maya-legal - due +2 days
- docs + 45s script + one-pager - owner: hugo-marketing - due +3 days

ci-bot: CI note: artifacts must pass "embedding-dim" check and sha256 verification before marketplace ingestion. See https://internal.ci/packaging.

maya-legal: Also note: if any partner requests EU residency, add residency_notice.txt and don't include logs with IPs.

hugo-marketing: I'll draft the 45s script and record once mini_sample_50 is uploaded.

sam-partners: Great. I'll schedule a 15-min check-in 48 hours out. Ping here if any blocker.
